# stb

From https://github.com/nothings/stb (public domain or MIT, at your choice; see the end of each file), unchanged:
- `stb_image.h` v2.30: VADER reads PNG and JPG shape files with it (src/shapefile.c).
- `stb_image_write.h` v1.16 (commit 2c980bb5): VADER writes your own shape's screen pictures with it (src/pictures.c).
